id: Nihile...
en: Nihile...
it: Nihile...

id: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
en: \rYou look tired. Why don't you take a rest.
it: \rSembri stanco. Perché non ti riposi un po'?

id: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great. Take care now!
en: \rOh, good! You and your Pokémon are looking great.  Take care now!
it: \rOh, bene! Tu e i tuoi Pokémon avete un ottimo aspetto. Abbi cura di te!

id: \bGladion: Our father was here. This entire time he was here.
en: \bGladion: Our father was here. This entire time he was here.
it: \bIridio: Nostro padre era qui. Per tutto questo tempo è stato qui.

id: \bWelcome to Freezington. I'm the mayor of this small town.
en: \bWelcome to Freezington. I'm the mayor of this small town.
it: \bBenvenuto a Freezington. Sono il sindaco di questo piccolo paese.

id: \bYou're looking for a strange Pokémon. Ah, I think I know what you're talking about. I saw it in the Crown Tundra. It was white and yellow.
en: \bYou're looking for a strange Pokémon. Ah, I think I know what you're talking about. I saw it in the Crown Tundra. It was white and yellow.
it: \bStai cercando uno strano Pokémon. Ah, credo di sapere di cosa parli. L'ho visto nella Landa Corona. Era bianco e giallo.

id: \bI wish I could tell you more, but there was a blizzard at the time.
en: \bI wish I could tell you more, but there was a blizzard at the time.
it: \bVorrei poterti dire di più, ma in quel momento c'era una bufera di neve.

id: \bIt was a Nihilego? I'm not familiar with that Pokémon.
en: \bIt was a Nihilego? I'm not familiar with that Pokémon.
it: \bEra un Nihilego? Non conosco quel Pokémon.

id: \bEither way, thank you for letting me know it's not a threat. The villagers will be relieved to know it is safe again. Take this as my thanks.
en: \bEither way, thank you for letting me know it's not a threat. The villagers will be relieved to know it is safe again. Take this as my thanks.
it: \bIn ogni caso, grazie per avermi fatto sapere che non è una minaccia. Gli abitanti saranno sollevati di sapere che è di nuovo tutto sicuro. Prendi questo come ringraziamento.

id: \bThank you again for finding that Pokémon. Feel free to stay as long as you like.
en: \bThank you again for finding that Pokémon. Feel free to stay as long as you like.
it: \bGrazie ancora per aver trovato quel Pokémon. Resta pure quanto vuoi.

id: \rLusamine: We found him. At long last, our family is together again.
en: \rLusamine: We found him. At long last, our family is together again.
it: \rSamina: L'abbiamo trovato. Finalmente la nostra famiglia è di nuovo unita.

id: \rA visitor? We don't ever see people like that around here.
en: \rA visitor? We don't ever see people like that around here.
it: \rUn visitatore? Qui non si vede mai gente del genere.

id: \rLedian
en: \rLedian
it: \rLedian

id: \bMohn: I suffered from memory loss for years. This Pokémon brought me back from Ultra Space and took care of me.
en: \bMohn: I suffered from memory loss for years. This Pokémon brought me back from Ultra Space and took care of me.
it: \bMohn: Ho sofferto di amnesia per anni. Questo Pokémon mi ha riportato indietro dall'Ultramondo e si è preso cura di me.

id: \bIt's finally time I returned home. Please, come with us in our celebration.
en: \bIt's finally time I returned home. Please, come with us in our celebration.
it: \bÈ finalmente ora che torni a casa. Ti prego, unisciti a noi nei festeggiamenti.

id: \rAre you a strong Trainer? Do you seek out rare an exciting adventures?
en: \rAre you a strong Trainer? Do you seek out rare an exciting adventures?
it: \rSei un Allenatore forte? Sei in cerca di avventure rare ed emozionanti?

id: \rThat's good to hear. I've been holding onto this for years, but I'm not a good fit for it. Please, take it and use it.
en: \rThat's good to hear. I've been holding onto this for years, but I'm not a good fit for it. Please, take it and use it.
it: \rMi fa piacere sentirlo. Lo custodisco da anni, ma non fa per me. Ti prego, prendilo e usalo.

id: \rNeither am I. Neither am I...
en: \rNeither am I. Neither am I...
it: \rNeanch'io. Neanch'io...

id: \rI hope you use it. Don't become someone with regrets like me.
en: \rI hope you use it. Don't become someone with regrets like me.
it: \rSpero che lo userai. Non diventare una persona piena di rimpianti come me.

id: \rLillie: Father. I'm so happy to see you again.
en: \rLillie: Father. I'm so happy to see you again.
it: \rLylia: Papà. Sono così felice di rivederti.

id: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
en: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
it: \bSono il Maniaco delle Mosse Pokémon.

id: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
en: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
it: \bConosco ogni singola mossa che i Pokémon imparano crescendo.

id: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
en: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
it: \bColleziono anche Squame Cuore.

id: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
en: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
it: \bSe me ne porti una, insegnerò una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
en: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
it: \bOh! Eccola! È una Squama Cuore autentica al cento per cento!

id: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
en: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
it: \bFammi indovinare, vuoi che insegni una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
en: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
it: \bQuale Pokémon ha bisogno di lezioni?

id: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
en: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
it: \bSe i tuoi Pokémon devono imparare una mossa, torna con una Squama Cuore.

id: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
en: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
it: \bEh? Non c'è nemmeno una mossa che possa insegnare a un Uovo.

id: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
en: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
it: \bNeanche per sogno, non voglio avvicinarmi a un Pokémon Ombra...

id: \bSorry...
en: \bSorry...
it: \bMi dispiace...

id: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
en: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
it: \bA quanto pare non ho nessuna mossa da insegnare al tuo \v[3].

id: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
en: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
it: \bQuale mossa devo insegnare al tuo \v[3]?

id: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
en: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
it: \PN ha consegnato una Squama Cuore in cambio.

id: Yes
en: Yes
it: Sì

en: No
